facts.text: I am trying to organize my concert memories from the past few months.
I saw Arctic Monkeys at Red Rocks.
The Arctic Monkeys show at Red Rocks was already two months ago.
I went to a music festival in San Francisco a week after the Arctic Monkeys show.
I went to a Phoebe Bridgers concert at The Fillmore the following weekend.
I went to a music festival where Tame Impala performed.
I went to a music festival where Billie Eilish performed.
I went to a music festival where The 1975 performed.
I met a girl named Rachel at the music festival.
Rachel shared her portable charger with me.
I went to see The Who at the Oakland Arena about a month ago.
I attended an outdoor concert at the Greek Theatre in Berkeley.
I saw the electronic duo Disclosure at the Greek Theatre in Berkeley.
I went to see Bon Iver at the Orpheum Theatre in San Francisco a few days ago.
